strategy.app: Keep carts, orders, order items and inventory for one transaction in the same APP database. Before 450 MiB, archive closed historical data into a dated APP archive database instead of splitting a live transaction.
strategy.inci: Before 450 MiB, provision the next INCI shard and route canonical ingredients by a stable normalized-name range. A single ingredient and all aliases/functions stay in one shard.
strategy.rawArchives: Crawler source records and immutable exports belong in R2, not runtime D1 databases.
strategy.provisioning: Do not reserve empty databases. Create the next shard only after the 400 MiB warning and before the 450 MiB gate is reached.
